author: Jay
name: PZAdmin
short: Project Zomboid server status and restarts via PZAdmin.
description: Shows Project Zomboid server status and who is online, and lets approved users trigger a graceful restart. The bot only talks to PZAdmin's HTTP API; PZAdmin does the RCON and container work itself.
install_msg: Set up with [p]pzadminset url <pzadmin url> (e.g. http://192.168.0.50:27815), then DM the bot: [p]set api pzadmin api_key <key>. Check it with [p]pzadminset show. For slash commands: [p]slash enable pz, [p]slash enable pzctl, then [p]slash sync. The key needs the control scope for restarts. Lock down restarts with [p]permissions setdefaultglobalrule deny pzctl, then allow specific users with [p]permissions addglobalrule allow pzctl <user>.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
